description.value:
One half of the Libra Cloth's Nunchaku (Sōsetsukon) — the right hand.

1d6 bludgeoning, one hand each, flail group; agile, backswing, finesse, magical, trip, twin.

An Arm always arrives as both weapons at once, one in each hand: summon or dismiss it with @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Summon an Arm]. It can never be disarmed, sundered, or destroyed, and it accepts weapon runes normally.

A Libra Saint uses their unarmed proficiency with it, and it grows on its own along the Arms Advance — potency, striking, and a fifth damage die at 19th level — without ever being bought or etched. @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Cosmo Strike] applies to it exactly as it does to the Saint's fists.

While you wield the matched pair you gain its Art, @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Rebound Rhythm].

An ally lent an Arm by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.The Twelve Arms] uses the Saint's proficiency, receives the Saint's Arms Advance, and gains the Art.
